title: Strengthen review contracts and add AL reliability guidance
summary: Adds seven AL reliability rules with good and bad samples: two on outbound HttpClient failure and status handling, and five on base quantities, SetFilter placeholders, test isolation, JSON null checks and format 9. The review framework also gets deterministic layered skill precedence and a findings-report validator.
key_points: Two HttpClient rules: separate transport failure from HTTP responses, and check the status before using the response body
Five more rules: base quantity derivation, SetFilter filter placeholders, per-test state reset before IsInitialized, JSON null checks, standard format 9
Layered action-skill overrides follow custom > community > microsoft precedence with deterministic resolution and fallback (Resolve-SkillWorklist.ps1)
Validate-FindingsReport.ps1 enforces the findings-report schema and semantic acceptance rules
Evaluation coverage is measurable, and changed paired articles must be selected or explicitly waived
quote: Adds five source-backed rules, each with focused good/bad AL samples, routing keywords/checks, and deterministic evaluation coverage
